Class TUIView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.view.TUIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewType
public class TUIView extends Object implements ViewType
The TUIView class implements the ViewType interface and provides a text-based user interface for the game. It manages the terminal input and output, renders game events, and interacts with the client model and controller to facilitate user commands and display game information. The class uses the JLine library to handle terminal interactions and supports various commands for connecting to a server, creating or joining games, picking cards, placing totems, and displaying game information.

Supported Commands:

  • help - Displays a comprehensive list of all available commands and their usage
  • connect [socket|rmi] - Establishes a connection to the server using the specified protocol. Prompts for server IP, port, and player nickname. Validates that the client is not already connected
  • exit - Terminates the application and closes the terminal
  • create [numPlayers] [totemColor] - Creates a new game session with the specified number of players and assigns the caller's totem color
  • join [gameId] [totemColor] - Joins an existing game identified by gameId and assigns the caller's totem color
  • pick [cardID] - Selects and plays a card identified by its numeric ID during the game phase
  • place [position] - Places the player's totem at the specified board position (case-insensitive)
  • show [option] [args] - Displays game information based on the specified option:
    • show nickname [nickname] - Displays information about a specific player
    • show cardId [cardId] - Displays the description of a card by its ID
    • show board - Displays the current state of the game board with all cards and tracks
    • show turnOrderCard - Displays the turn order card with player order and food values
    • show gameHistory - Displays the complete history of events from the current game

Each command is case-insensitive. Invalid commands trigger an error message prompting the user to type 'help' for command information. Command-specific exceptions (IllegalArgumentException, RuntimeException) are caught and displayed to the user without terminating the application loop.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run() throws IOException
      Starts the view and handles user input.

      This method initializes the terminal and line reader, prints the game title, and enters an interactive loop to read and process user commands. The method manages the text-based user interface and delegates command execution to specialized handler methods.

      Specified by:
      run in interface ViewType
      Throws:
      IOException - If an IOException occurs during terminal initialization or if a critical I/O error occurs during input reading
      RuntimeException - If an EndOfFileException or UserInterruptException is caught (e.g., Ctrl+D or Ctrl+C), indicating the user wants to exit the application

    • update

      public void update(ClientModel model, ViewEvent event)
      Updates the view based on the provided model and event. If no model has yet been assigned, it assigns the provided model to the view and sets the chosen nickname to the home player's nickname. Finally, it calls the render method of the event, passing this view as an argument.
      Specified by:
      update in interface ViewType
      Parameters:
      model - the client model to update the view with
      event - the event that triggered the update

    • renderLogin

      public void renderLogin(String message)
      Renders a Login message to the user.

      This method synchronizes on the renderLock object to ensure thread safety while rendering the login message. It uses the lineReader to print the message above the current input line, prefixed with "[Server]: ".

      Specified by:
      renderLogin in interface ViewType
      Parameters:
      message - the message to render

    • renderEndGame

      public void renderEndGame(String message)
      Renders a message indicating that the game has ended.

      This method adds the provided message to the game history, constructs a scoreboard string based on the final player rankings and their prestige points, and synchronizes on the renderLock object to ensure thread safety while rendering the end game message. It uses the lineReader to print the message above the current input line, prefixed with "[Server]: ", followed by the constructed scoreboard.

      Specified by:
      renderEndGame in interface ViewType
      Parameters:
      message - the message to render

    • renderDisconnection

      public void renderDisconnection(String message)
      Renders a message indicating that a player has disconnected from the game.

      This method sets the model reference to null, clears the game history, and synchronizes on the renderLock object to ensure thread safety while rendering the disconnection message. It uses the lineReader to clear the screen and print the disconnection message above the current input line, prefixed with "[Server]: ", followed by instructions for the user to join or create a new game.

      Specified by:
      renderDisconnection in interface ViewType
      Parameters:
      message - the message to render

    • handleNetworkError

      public void handleNetworkError(String errorMessage)
      Handles a network error by displaying an error message to the user.

      This method synchronizes on the renderLock object to ensure thread safety while rendering the network error message. It uses the lineReader to print the message above the current input line, prefixed with "[Network Error]: ", followed by instructions for the user to return to the main menu. It then resets the chosen nickname and model reference, and calls the printGameTitle method to display the game title.

      Specified by:
      handleNetworkError in interface ViewType
      Parameters:
      errorMessage - the network error message to render
